name: com.aidancmays.objectives
description: Networked objectives for Netcode for GameObjects: objectives placed anywhere in a level, a host-authoritative tracker that syncs their state to clients without making each one a NetworkObject, gates that stay shut until every required objective is done, two ready-made objective types (pressure plates, hold an area), and items an objective hands out for players to set on pedestals at a receptacle. A debug panel lists and completes objectives.
